newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia and Italy discuss minorities, investment.
newsitem.headline: Croatia and Italy discuss minorities, investment.

text.p: Foreign ministers Lamberto Dini of Italy and Mate Granic of Croatia met in Zagreb on Tuesday to discuss minority rights and investment.

The two were expected to sign two bilateral accords, one on the protection of ethnic Italians in the Croatian districts of Istria and Dalmatia, and the other on the promotion and protection of bilateral investments.
"This is an extremely important visit for Croatia," Croatian assistant Foreign Minister Hido Biscevic told the state news agency Hina.
He said Dini's one-day trip was one of the first foreign visits in which the main topic would not be the situation in Bosnia.
Croatia expected Italian support in achieving its key strategic goal -- joining the European Union and NATO, he added.
Croatian President Franjo Tudjman is also expected to receive Dini during his visit.
